lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His voice echoes through empty aisles.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This place is creepy. Where are all the employees?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: The shelves are still stocked, but everything's covered in dust.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke walks through the store, disturbed by the silence.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You know, I wished I didn't have to deal with shopping... but this is worse.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: At least in a normal store, there are people. People who can help.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The floor begins to crack beneath his feet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Strange creatures emerge from the cracks.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I need to get out of here!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: There! A tunnel in the back!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: With no other choice, Luke enters the dark tunnel.
